notes: Version 2.1 makes O26 consistent with its own Hypothesis 4.4 and with the deposited O29 2.0. New Proposition 4.7 (symmetric-square bound): under condition (a) of Hypothesis 4.4, each Level III outer product is u u^T, so the trajectory spans at most Sym^2(V_rho), of dimension d(d+1)/2 (3 for d = 2), and the rank-four target d_rho^2 = 4 of the original Test 4 criterion is excluded under that contract; other embeddings and constructions are not refuted. This bound is propagated to the abstract, the original criterion, Remark 5.5, the decision-table remark, the implications and the outlook, and to the README. Involution compatibility of the matrix coefficients (criterion (i) and Test 1) is stated as holding by construction for any vectors, without using the conjugation identity, so Test 1 is an implementation check that does not discriminate Levels II and III. Test 4 is described as a finite-data diagnostic of the measured carrier H_eff, not of End(V_rho): the tested conjugate-pair samples do not reach rank four; r_eff = 3 holds for every tested pair at q in {29, 61, 151}, for 103/105 pairs at q = 211 and as the modal value (32/50) at q = 101, and multi-sample follow-ups give modal rank three for every exceptional pair; since those data are formed in End(H_eff) and include no run of Tests 1-3, they occupy no row of the decision table; the numerical 6 -> 3 Veronese collapse and so(3) constraint pattern, found at q in {29, 61}, are compatible with the adjoint carrier H_eff = su(2), which is conditional on O23's supplied carrier and O27's admissible-saturation hypothesis and is not identified by the data. A bare effective rank different from three is no longer read as bearing on the carrier. The rank-four statement about the O29 samples is restricted to Sym(H_eff, C); the locking-broken control recovers four operator directions only in an auxiliary PCA truncation. O27 is credited with a conditional sector reading, not a sector identification; the independent observable and the typed bridge to V_rho are recorded as open in O29. The abstract no longer contains citation commands. Remarks 5.5 and 6.1 are retitled and Section 5 is retitled 'Diagnostic criteria and their scope'. The README restores the complex conjugation in the definition of the matrix coefficient, so that it designates the same object as the paper (the difference is invisible for the real Weil-side residual vectors but changes the embedded products under condition (a) from symmetric to Hermitian), states the symmetric-square bound, and retypes its falsifiability heading and claims as diagnostics. The decision table separates implementation failures (Tests 1-2) from a dictionary failure (Test 3), aligns the 'r_eff variable' row with the original criterion, and records that r_eff = 3 equals the Level III bound under condition (a) and so does not discriminate; End(V_rho) is described as the ambient, not minimal, space. The d_rho = 2 minimality selection, the statement of Hypothesis 4.4 and the O27 factorisation statements are unchanged.
